card.name: Digits inside numbers in data
card.fires_on: A single digit in the middle of a decimal or multi-digit figure, such as the 9 in 68.9°F or the 4 in 2.40, mostly in statistics, climate, census or table data. It also fires weakly on a few words in running text about asteroids.

modes.label: Digit inside a figure
modes.description: A digit partway through a decimal or comma-separated number, with more digits still to come.
modes.example: The average in July in Stockbridge is 68.<<9>>°F (20.5°C).

modes.label: Digit in a table or range
modes.description: A digit within a value in a results table or confidence interval.

modes.description: A weak response to a word in sentences about asteroids.
